faq.title: Answers before you start.
faq.q1: Does PetStock work on mobile phones?
faq.a1: Yes, PetStock is a web platform. You can access your account from your mobile, tablet, or computer browser comfortably without installing anything extra.
faq.q2: Can I register products with minimum stock alerts?
faq.a2: Of course! When registering products, you can set a minimum stock level. The system will alert you on time when inventory drops below that threshold.
faq.q3: Can I check my customers' purchase history?
faq.a3: Yes, PetStock keeps a complete sales history. You can look up customer info and past purchases to keep everything organized and make data-driven decisions.
faq.q4: Do I need technical skills to use PetStock?
faq.a4: Not at all. We designed the interface with clear colors and readable fonts to make store management very intuitive.
